notes.title: Introducing our next game: Arcane Eats
notes.notes:
After years of updates and support for Roundguard, we’re very excited to finally announce our next game, Arcane Eats! It’s a roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist – build a cuisine-themed deck of cards, cook up combos on magical cooktops, and serve fantastical meals to hordes of hungry monsters. It’s crisp and crunchy card play tossed in roguelike spices with a heaping side of culinary puns.

[previewyoutube=PLhMNrP52Us;full][/previewyoutube]

I’m a big foodie and I love games about cooking, but I’ve always felt like there’s something missing. Most cooking games focus on following recipes and speedy execution. Cooking can be about that for sure, but the kind of cooking I love most happens when you let go of following a recipe – when you improvise with the ingredients you have at hand, when you experiment to find new taste combos, when you try to understand the underlying mechanics so you can make your prep work even more efficient or your dish even more delicious. Cooking like that is exciting, it’s clever, and it’s risky – sometimes you fail! And also, it sounds a lot like a roguelike, doesn’t it? Stir that together with my everlasting love of nerdy card games, and you’ve got the flavorful foundation that came together to make Arcane Eats.

I can get into the weeds talking about cooking – it’s dear to my belly – and from soup to nuts, this game is thoroughly infused with cooking themes. But make no mistake, Arcane Eats is a deep and strategic deckbuilder at its heart. We’ve drawn inspiration from some of our favorites, like Slay the Spire, Monster Train, Magic the Gathering and Hearthstone, so if you like the taste of those games, you’ll find plenty here to sink your teeth into.

We’ve been simmering in secrecy for more than a year waiting to tell you all about Arcane Eats, and I’m so excited we finally get to share! Now that we’ve announced, we’ll be handing out info appetizers more regularly, so don’t forget to [url=http://eepurl.com/cYbdL1]join our newsletter[/url] and we’ll keep you fed. And of course, if you’re the kind of person who enjoys a seat at the chef’s table, chatting with us as we work and maybe getting a chance to be a taste *tester*, please please come join us in our new Arcane Eats channel on [url=https://discord.gg/wonderbellygames]our Discord server[/url]! We’re hanging out there all the time, and we’d love to hear which fantasy monsters are on the top of your bucket list to make into meals.
 
Oh, and don’t forget to wishlist Arcane Eats!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640090 

Flavorfully yours,
Andrea at Wonderbelly Games

notes.title: The Encore 2.0 Update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Today we’re rolling out yet another free major content update, the Encore update! This huge expansion gives each hero their own series of escalating Encore ranks to explore, and adds tons of new gameplay variety and new rewards to unlock if you can survive it all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/7d33e63748af4bbb1db27be0ee5455199f7b92cd.gif[/img]

[b]New Encore mode![/b] Once you complete a normal run for the first time, you now unlock Encore mode. Each Encore rank adds new variety and challenge, encouraging you to experiment with each hero. The higher you can climb in a hero’s ranks, the higher the difficulty and the more gold potential each run holds. The upper limits of the leaderboards are now anyone’s guess!

[b]New bosses![/b] Too comfy with the Alchemist, the Cycloptopus, and the Giant Worm? We’ve flooded the dungeon with new variants! Try your hand at defeating these new dangerous lab experiments, answer the question of how many Cycloptopi you can fit in a room, and discover the inner workings of a steampunk robotic Worm.

[b]Unique Sideshows![/b] Each hero has a special Sideshow rank with completely new rules and challenges. Race against a ticking time bomb, push your luck with two treasure scarabs, defend your potions from those thirsty imps, and fight off a wave of fungal infection.

[b]The Wheel of Woes![/b] If you can survive up to Encore rank 3, you’ll see Ledger’s newest toy, the Wheel of Woes! Take a spin every act to take on a new game-altering rule that will make navigating the dungeon even trickier than before.

[b]5 new Relics, including one that unlocks Endless Mode![/b] That’s right, by popular demand, you can now tackle Endless Mode. Take that lucky OP build and see just how far it can carry you as the dungeon’s challenges keep escalating for as long as it takes.

[b]More![/b] 16 new challenging achievements. New accessibility settings for Game Speed and Arachnophobia mode. Lots and lots of balancing tweaks and polish to address issues you all helped point out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/cbd495199443eeb2e892cf389b7dfab2a4304ed7.gif[/img]

This update brings us up to a solid version 2.0, two years after we first launched. Over the years, we’ve made the game bigger and better for free, adding a new playable hero class, daily & weekly challenges, seasonal events, new bosses, elites, monsters, relics, items, levels, achievements, and more. Thank you all for sticking with us through this journey!

After all that, it feels fitting that another awesome Peggle-inspired roguelike [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296610/Peglin/]Peglin[/url] has started their journey into early access this week. They have a really interesting ball power-up mechanic and a different spin on the whole thing that is definitely worth checking it out. We’ll be releasing a Pegglelike bundle with them to celebrate at the start of the Going Rogue sale next week, so keep your eye out for that!

<3
Andrea, Wonderbelly Games

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Encore mode now unlocks after winning a run with any hero. Each hero has 5 levels of Encore ranks plus a unique Sideshow to complete, each adding interesting new rules and rewards. 
[*] Added new bosses: The Mad Virologist, the Mad Doctor, Greg & Carl, Bleary, Blinky & Goo, the Robotic Heart, and the Infected Heart.
[*] Added new monsters & hazards: Thirsty Imp, Strange Lab Rat, Toxic Mushroom, Doc’s Monster, Doc’s Helper, Plasma Globes, Robo Wormlet, Infected Wormlet, Sickly Valve.
[*] Added the Trinket limiter, encouraging you to make more strategic choices around Trinkets. 
[*] Added the Wheel of Woes with 32 different rules to alter the dungeon and keep you on your toes. 
[*] Added 5 new relics to unlock, including Endless Mode to really put your skills to the test.
[*] Added Game Speed settings menu options for changing physics simulation speed.
[*] Added Arachnophobia Mode to the settings menu to change spiders to cute lil’ blobs with no legs and a reasonable amount of eyes and remove icky sound effects.
[*] Added 16 new achievements. Can you beat the top Encore rank with any hero? Can you get a scarab multiplier of 20x? (Yes, that’s possible now!)
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added +10 to the Warrior's starting health and increased the amount of health he gets on most level ups.
[*] Troll & Ice Giant regen amount lowered.
[*] Changed Gold Lust to give health immediately on use as well as per pot.
[*] Changed quests with longer form goals so that they can't be given too close to the end of the game.
[*] Changed the trigger conditions on the Gel Tamer's and the Goblin Poet's so that it's now more likely that you'll encounter the giants / spiders required to complete their quests.
[*] Changed the Gel Tamer's trinket Cube Whistle: "Take no negative status effects from Gelly Cubes. They only move when you fast forward."
[*] Added "Take no negative effects from Gelly Cubes" to the Cube Whistle.
[*] Added "Equipment in Brutes rooms is 1 level higher" to Grandma's Pearls.
[*] Added "+5 mana per skull smashed" to Lich's Spell Book.
[*] Changed Lyric Book to ALWAYS make orcs vulnerable (instead of first turn).
[*] Increased Ballet Slippers evade chance to 10% (up from 5).
[*] Added "Skeletons are no longer immune to Weaken" to Talisman of Mild Softening.
[*] Added an additional new trinket to the Gold Wheel of Wonders pool. Disinfecting Wipes: Remove all negative status effects when you land on the cushion.
[*] Moved Good Luck Charm and Protector's Ring into Blue Wheel of Wonders pool (from Red and Gold respectively).
[*] Moved Fluffy Robe of Restoration and Pendulum Power Pendant up to Gold Wheel of Wonders pool (from Blue).
[*] Increased gold value of Summoner Skeletons and Dark Elf Illusionists to make up for lost gold pots they replace on the board.
[*] Reduced the number of times you have to hit a broken peg before it poofs out of your way to 3 (from 5).
[*] Increased Cycloptopus gold values.
[*] Combining Curiosity and Fervor relics no longer results in 100% chaos rooms.
[/list]
[h3]Polish & Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed druid blooms sometimes not appearing after switching armors (until you save/load again). 
[*] Fixed druid treant charge cooldown time being slightly too long if you didn't have the "charge further" bonus property.
[*] Effects that target the nearest enemy now pick a random direction if there are no enemies to target (instead of always going to the right).
[*] If you're playing with a short aimer rule and you get the long aimer trinket, those rules now cancel each other out and you have a normal aimer (instead of keeping the small aimer)
[*] Druid wild vines properties & trinkets that make it target more pots now stack correctly if you have multiple copies of those bonus properties/trinkets.
[*] Fixed final boss so all enemies' health & damage scale with level appropriately now. (Previously only relevant if using Relics to boost enemy level)
[*] Fixed Concentration relic logic so that your streak isn't broken if a skeleton minotaur hits the scarab before the start of the first round.
[*] Fixed Diligence relic logic so it no longer deducts health for the turn you actually clear all gold pots.
[*] Fixed save/load issue with Cycloptopus that could make the big eye not become vulnerable after hitting a little eye. 
[*] Fixed Rogue arrow property "double damage vs poisoned enemies" and Woodland Garb's double damage not stacking correctly. 
[*] While pausing/quitting, the game now stays frozen if you quit mid shot (rather than resuming the bounce and making weird things happen). 
[*] Fixed soft lock that could occur if you skipped the Gift Giver's final reward dialog.
[*] Made beam conductor dark elves not connect beams to/from any elves who are blind.
[*] Fixed rune totem to show correct visual state after save/load
[*] Fixed blind feedback (besides the icon) not showing up after save load
[*] Fixed Cycloptopus not save/loading all the eye states correctly. 
[*] Enabled opening the map and equipment screens while receiving the trinket from the Wheel of Wonders
[*] Fixed Druid Thornbirds not passing through the tricky disappearing Grim Grifter presents. 
[*] Fixed Druid Thornbirds not passing through the Cycloptopus big eye when it's closed. 
[*] Fixed soft lock from save/load during Druid create sprouts in first turn quest.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Druid's winter event costume.
[*] Fixed some quests not triggering completion when they should.
[*] Fixed particles from air blasts that push you around disappearing too early. Now if you are going to get pushed, you should see the particles, even after freezing time to pause/aim/etc.
[*] Fixed a Cyclotopus bug that could get the big eye stuck closed during the turn it should have been stuck open. 
[*] Fixed armored skeletons losing their invulnerability after save/load.
[*] Fixed UI bug with druid sprout quest displaying the wrong number in some situations.
[*] Druid Wild Vines targeting with the d-pad when using a controller now keeps the highlight on the gold pot the correct size for larger pots.
[*] Fixed final boss little worm butt bits so they no longer get destroyed by some invisible colliders associated with non-damaging properties/skills. 
[*] Fixed bug where The Projectionist elite would only reliably show up for the warrior after receiving her intro dialog.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed repeated encounters with the same elite before they should be seen again.
[*] Fixed extremely rare crash that could happen in final boss fight at the moment of victory.
[*] Fixed hero projectiles getting deleted as soon as they were fired if you were too high above the board. (overly aggressive out of bounds clean up logic)
[*] Fixed Gift Giver not progressing his quest line if you completed the quest but dropped the trinket. 
[*] Fixed Polymorph Staff frogs getting cleaned up after each round instead of waiting around for you to bonk them.
[*] Fixed soft lock with the final boss fight if you polymorphed certain enemies in that room.
[*] Fixed the Alchemist’s poison potions hurting the hero for an extra turn beyond normal poison stacks.
[/list]

notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary + v2.0 Beta!
notes.notes:
Hey friends!

Can you believe it’s been 2 years since Roundguard first launched?! Ever since that fateful Friday the 13th, just as the world entered pandemic lockdown, we’ve been making Roundguard bigger and better with lots of major updates and minor patches. We've added daily puzzles, weekly runs, a new hero, new enemies, new relics, silly Halloween and winter holiday events, and more...

Well, we’re not done yet! [b]We’ve got our biggest update of them all, The Encore Update, nearly complete, but we need your help to finish prepping it for prime time.[/b] The Encore update is loaded with new content, challenges, rewards, and high score potential, in addition to a ton of bug fixes and polish. 

Here’s the deal - Once you complete a normal run for the first time, you now unlock Encore mode. 

Each hero has 5 Encore ranks to climb, plus a unique Sideshow with special rules just for them. The higher you climb the ranks, the tougher things will get, but the more gold potential there is for you to make your mark on the leaderboards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/bf7a7fed17b9eb8877a65dcbe68745bc217bef24.png[/img]

By playing on these Encore ranks, you’ll unlock some major stuff the community has asked for, like:
[list]
[*] Boss variety at the end of each Act.
[*] The ability to sell trinkets and make more careful strategic choices about your build. 
[*] The Wheel of Woes will shake up each run and make you choose your path through the map more carefully than ever. 
[*] 5 new Relics, including “Endless Mode” to push your build strategies to their limits.
[*] 16 new challenging achievements.
[*] And lots more cool new stuff to discover in each of the Sideshows! 
[/list]
We’ve also added new accessibility settings including Game Speed and Arachnophobia mode. If our spiders were keeping you from playing before, you should be able to complete a run without fear now! Well… with only your non-spider related fears at least. 

We’re [i]very[/i] excited about how all these new features push people to learn the mechanics of the game more deeply and strategize more thoughtfully, but we’d really appreciate your feedback on how it’s shaping up. We’d absolutely LOVE to hear from you about balance, bugs, or anything you want to share, so please come join the Beta branch and let us know what you think! 

Are the highest Encore ranks too hard? Are any of the Woes too woeful? Does the score UI textbox no longer fit the huge number you are able to achieve by comboing the right Relics on higher Encore ranks?

To join the beta, all you need to do is:
[olist]
[*] Own the game. (Oh look, it’s on sale right now!)
[*] Right-click on it and select Properties, and then the Betas tab.
[*] Enter the password [b]supersecretbetabranch[/b] .
[*] Select the beta branch from the dropdown menu.
[*] You did it!
[/olist]
In addition to reporting bugs and feedback through the in-game report button, come [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]join our Discord[/url] as well. It’s the perfect place to share your feedback, brag about your high score, or share your best / worst fantasy RPG puns.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

<3
Andrea, Wonderbelly Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4.4 Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Hey friends! Another update here with the last big new features before we focus on polish/balance and start localizing this thing. Please please PLEASE give us any feedback you’ve got about balance or bugs or anything that’s on your mind! 

To join the beta branch:
1. Right-click on the game in Steam and select Properties.
2. Select the BETAS tab and enter the password supersecretbetabranch
3. Select the beta branch from the dropdown.
4. It should update right away! You will know you’re on the beta build if you see a new version number in the lower right on the Roundguard title screen.
5. After you start the game up, if your save files don't copy over and you'd like to keep playing with your main game save progress, you can go to C:\Users\[your user name]\AppData\LocalLow\Wonderbelly Games\Roundguard and copy/paste the files from the "saves" folder into the "beta" folder.

Now for the details of what’s in the patch:

[h3]The Relic of Perseverance[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4.0 Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Hey friends! We’ve been hard at work on our next major content update – the Encore Update! – and we’re ready for those of you in the beta branch to take your first swing at it. We’ll be adding a lot more to it in the next few months, but we’ve made so many balance changes already, we’d love to hear some of your feedback now. So get playing and let us know what you think!

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] After you beat the game for the first time, we now unlock Encore ranks for each hero. Each rank is a higher tier of difficulty with tougher enemies, a more valuable scarab, and new rules that change up the game, adding new boss variants, a limit to how many trinkets you can carry, and a dangerous Wheel of Woes.
[*] Stay tuned for new ranks, relics, enemies, achievements, and… more!
[*] All of the new content is in English only at the moment and some of the text is missing or placeholder. You can still play in other languages, but it will show English strings where we’re missing translations for new content.
[*] With this build, we're splitting off the beta leaderboards from the main leaderboards, because y'all are about to get some wild scores. You can't show off to the whole world just yet, but you'll all be able to see how awesome other beta players are. I want to see your highest scores! Share them with us!
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the number of times you have to hit a broken peg before it poofs to 3 (from 5).
[*] Troll & Ice Giant regen amount lowered.
[*] Added +10 to the Warrior's starting health and increased the amount of health he gets on most level ups.
[*] Changed Gold Lust to give health immediately on use as well as per pot.
[*] Changed quests with longer form goals so that they can't be given too close to the end of the game.
[*] Changed the trigger conditions on the Gel Tamer and the Goblin Poet quest dialogues so that it's now more likely that you'll encounter the giants / spiders required to complete their quests.
[*] Increased gold value of Summoner Skeletons and Dark Elf Illusionists to make up for lost gold pots they replace on the board.
[/list]
[h3]Big Ol’ Trinket Rebalance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Take no negative effects from Gelly Cubes" to the Cube Whistle.
[*] Added "Equipment in Brutes rooms is 1 level higher" to Grandma's Pearls.
[*] Added "+5 mana per skull smashed" to Lich's Spell Book.
[*] Changed Lyric Book to ALWAYS make orcs vulnerable (instead of first turn).
[*] Increased Ballet Slippers evade chance to 10% (up from 5).
[*] Added "Skeletons are no longer immune to Weaken" to Talisman of Mild Softening.
[*] Changed the Gel Tamer's trinket Cube Whistle: "Take no negative status effects from Gelly Cubes. They only move when you fast forward."
[*] Added an additional new trinket to the Gold Wheel of Wonders pool: Remove all negative status effects when you land on the cushion.
[*] Moved Good Luck Charm and Protector's Ring into Blue Wheel of Wonders pool (from Red and Gold respectively).
[*] Moved Fluffy Robe of Restoration and Pendulum Power Pendant up to Gold Wheel of Wonders pool (from Blue).
[/list]
[h3]Polish & Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enabled opening the map and equipment screens while receiving the trinket from the Wheel of Wonders.
[*] Fixed Druid Thornbirds not passing through the tricky disappearing Grim Grifter presents. 
[*] Fixed Druid Thornbirds not passing through the Cycloptopus’s big eye when it's closed. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed druid blooms sometimes not appearing after switching armors (until you save/load again). 
[*] Fixed druid treant charge cooldown time being slightly too long if you didn't have the "charge further" bonus property.
[*] Effects that target the nearest enemy now pick a random direction if there are no enemies to target (instead of always going to the right).
[*] If you're playing with a short aimer rule and you get the long aimer trinket, those rules now cancel each other out and you have a normal aimer (instead of keeping the small aimer)

[*] Fixed final boss so all enemies' health & damage scale with level appropriately now. (Previously only relevant if using Relics to boost enemy level)
[*] Fixed Concentration relic logic so that your streak isn't broken if a minotaur hits the scarab before the start of the first round.
[*] Fixed Diligence relic logic so it no longer deducts health for the turn you actually clear all gold pots.

[*] While pausing/quitting, the game now stays frozen if you quit mid shot (rather than resuming the bounce and making weird things happen). 
[*] Fixed soft lock that could occur if you skipped the Gift Giver's final reward dialog.
[*] Made beam conductor dark elves not connect beams to/from any elves who are blind.
[*] Fixed rune totem to show correct visual state after save/load
[*] Fixed blind feedback (besides the icon) not showing up after save load
[*] Fixed Cycloptopus not save/loading all the eye states correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: The Druid Update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Today we added a new playable hero, Sprig the Druid, in a free content update!

Sprig is more than just your garden variety druid. Every time she smashes a gold pot, she plants a fresh sprout in its place, changing up the rules of the board and spreading the wilds everywhere she goes. Her new skills give her tons of control, allowing her to jump, teleport, and summon friends across the board to smash that treasure scarab wherever its hiding. She's still a tender-shoot, so keeping her alive can be a challenge, but her score potential is through the forest canopy.

[previewyoutube=8TOpdqH2Z7o;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]New skills![/b] Sprig can summon vines and birds, teleport between her sprouts, and even transform into a giant, angry tree. Her skills make you think about bounce angles and board possibilities in a whole new way.

[b]New items![/b] Sprig comes loaded with a new set of weapons and armor. Her equipment creates new combo opportunities with her sprouts, changing their flower effects and growing more powerful as her sprouts spread across the board.

[b]New quests![/b] Test your green thumb and prove yourself to the Elder Tree to earn new trinkets. Each quest comes packed with a freshly-picked peck of plant puns.

[b]And more![/b] New daily & weekly challenges featuring the Druid, and six more achievements!

I want to give an extra big shout out to everyone who helped with the beta test. Sprig has really bloomed thanks to your feedback. Hope you all have a lovely, flower-filled summer! And hey, look at that: It's Summer Sale time! Roundguard will be 51% off, so now's the perfect time to pick it up / gift it to a friend / play the Druid while you're killing time deciding how much you can stuff in your cart. 😎 

<3
Andrea, Wonderbelly Games

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New playable hero: Sprig the Druid! She has an all new collection of skills, weapons, and armor brimming with mystical powers fresh from the wilds.
[*] New peg type: Sprouts! Whenever Sprig smashes a gold pot, it is instantly removed and replaced with a friendly little sprout. Sprig can do all sorts of things with her sprouts, including teleport between them, summon critters from them, and change which type of helpful flowers bloom from them.
[*] New status effect: Barkskin! Someone with barkskin will block that much damage on their next hit. It’s only removed when it is used. It never wears off on its own.
[*] New status effect: Thorns! Someone with thorns takes bonus damage for each thorn whenever they are hurt. This status effect never wears off.
[*] New quests and trinkets! Meet the Elder Tree, find out what Sprig thinks about watching grass grow, and add to your trinket collection with new items like Sticky Sap, Pruning Shears, and every dryad’s favorite: the Pocket Greenhouse.
[*] New daily puzzles and weekly challenges featuring the Druid!
[*] Six new achievements! Can you get 3 million gold? Or win a run in less than 75 shots?
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Random encounters between boards are slightly less frequent.
[*] Mimics can now be bubbled, just as the gods intended.
[*] Dropped max health on Glutton's Fork.
[*] A couple of powerful trinkets can now only be found deeper in the dungeon.
[*] Removed "gold per skill use" bonus property. Bye bye, infinite mana / infinite gold exploit.

[list]
[*] Added difficulty ratings to daily puzzles and weekly challenges.
[*] Fixed a bug in achievements so Payback should now work consistently for all players. 
[*] Equipping a new skill over an old one with only one skill equipped will automatically bump the old one into the empty slot.
[*] You no longer take damage from the spikes if you're petrified.
[*] Fixed a bug not getting slo mo drama cam when approaching the spikes sometimes.
[*] Now using a skill will override drama cam zoom, so you can see your targets better.
[*] Fixed rare soft lock if you polymorphed the last spiked blaster in the final boss fight.
[*] Fixed issue with getting blocked at the bosses when swapping between save slots and continuing runs under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a couple of boards that didn't have enough medium peg spots to support the Undead biome.
[*] Fixed some Japanese text overruns.
[*] Fixed bug where boards with snowballs would break the run if you had the Brilliance relic equipped. This bug involved an epic interaction between snowballs being melted by mana burn, and the ballista being unable to handle the resulting mass change in the snowballs. Long story short: roguelikes are wild, man.

Hello friends!

It's been one year since we launched and I believe the traditional first anniversary gift is a sale, isn't that right? Or is it loafers? Well, either way, we're celebrating with a big sale for Roundguard just about everywhere, so now's a good time to tell a friend to pick it up.

Yeah, so... One whole year, huh? It's hard to sum what the last year has meant for us. This was the first year Bob and I got to be full time indies -- a dream come true! Although with our daughter's preschool shut down due to COVID, it hasn't really been full time at all... It's been a stressful year, as I'm sure it's been for all of you. But it's also been so rewarding. Hearing stories about how Roundguard has been a fun activity for cooped up families, a way to introduce your partner to your love of roguelikes, or a kind distraction in a time of pain has consistently warmed our hearts. Thank you all so much for sharing with us.

And we've been completely blown away to see Roundguard nominated for a ton of lovely awards, including "Mobile Game of the Year" by the Golden Joystick Awards, "Best Mobile Game" by Destructoid and the New York Game Awards, "Best Apple Arcade Game" by the Pocket Gamer Awards, "Excellence in Game Design" by DevGAMM, and "Best Family Game of the Year" by the NAVGTR Awards.

But we haven't been resting on our round little laurels. In the last year, we've released the Treasure Hunter update, Halloween & Winter seasonal events, and the Gift Giver update, adding more game modes, monsters, unlocks, and tortured puns. [previewyoutube=LQly-DJ8aJM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Three New NPCs [/h3]
New characters are roaming the dungeon! There's the Big Freeze, an ice cold frost giant who hits like an avalanche and the Projectionist, a moody dark elf who wants to explore your emotions. And of course, there's the eponymous Gift Giver with gifts for you! He has a dramatic flair and an impeccable wrapping style. Complete his quests to prove your worth and he will reward you handsomely. Along with the new characters come new quests, trinkets, and elite fights!

[h3]Festive Winter Event [/h3]
From December 20th to January 2nd, there will be a special winter event full of frosty flair and festive cheer! The dungeon will be covered in snow and denizens will be dressed for the weather. There will also be two weeks of unique daily challenges using our new winter rules: Snowballing, which turns all pots to snowballs that stick to your hero, and Icy Winds, which blast through the levels and blow you around. Of course, a truly talented archer can also use the winds to fire trick shots around corners...

[h3]More the Merrier[/h3]
On top of that, we've added ten new board layouts (including several designed community members!), five new trinkets to unlock for the Wheel of Wonders, three new achievements, 🎵 and a partridge in a pear tree...🎵

Okay, maybe not that last one.

Besides the new stuff, we've done a few balance tweaks and a couple of bits of polish. I've put the full patch notes down at the bottom of this post.

Okay, what else? Well, you've made it down this far, so I know you're one of the good ones. Let me let you in a little secret. You know that "Set Seed" button on the character select screen?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/353713701b53058bec12772494ee3033202258d3.png[/img]

Well, it's not just for entering a seed to change how the dungeon is built. It's also for entering cheat codes! Here are a few we added:

"let it snow"          Cover the entire dungeon with snowballin' snowballs.
"blow me away"   Fight the icy winds through the whole dungeon.
"jingle bells"         Make the dungeon look frosty and festive at any time of year.
"spooky time"       Pretend it's Halloween again and get in costume.

There is one little trick to this if you want your run to be randomized and not seeded. After you enter the cheat code, open the seed menu back up and delete the code. That way, you'll clear out the seed so the dungeon will go back to randomly generating, but the cheat will still be turned on for the next run.

I hope you're all safe and you have some time this month to relax and get ready for a new year. This last year has been hard, but I want to thank you all for the kindness and generosity you've shared with us. You've made it a really special year for us too. I'm looking forward to having more to share with you in 2021!

<3
Andrea, Wonderbelly Games

notes.title: The Treasure Hunter Update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey treasure hunters,
Today we released our first major content update and it’s free for you, your best friend, your dog, and your coworker who always forgets to mute his mic on Zoom calls. That’s right, Roundguard is now bigger and better for everyone! There’s a lot of new stuff here, so let me give you an overview...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/f9e82bdc822aec2ec375e6fc59a1028eef343e16.gif[/img]
[h3]Daily Puzzles [/h3]
Every day there’s a unique bite-sized challenge with a game-changing twist, like “No gravity!” “Poison is permanent!” or “Defeat the room in two turns or die!” It’s perfect for a quick warm-up or if you only have 10 minutes to kill on your lunch break. If you can defeat the day’s challenge, you’ll earn a Golden Puzzle Piece.

[h3]Weekly Run[/h3]
Each week, there is a new 45-floor dungeon with a whole fresh set of twisted rules. All players face the exact same dungeon for a true head-to-head competition on the leaderboards. The person who claims the top spots each week gains the ultimate bragging rights -- only your first attempt counts for the leaderboards, so you’ll have to be a master of improvisation. But if the week’s run is too fiendish, you can always try again. And because it’s the same dungeon for everyone, you can strategize and share tips with others in the Roundguard community. You’ll earn a Golden Puzzle Piece just for trying out the week’s Run, and even more if you can claim victory and survive to the bottom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/870bc1ed32fe03e84c0e027206b060816dbd85d5.gif[/img]
[h3]Golden Puzzles[/h3]
Each Golden Puzzle Piece earned from playing the new modes helps you unlock new relics and bonus properties. You’ll be able to equip these new rewards in Normal Runs, so you can bring some of the rule-bending wackiness back with you into the main game. 

[h3]Top Score Relics[/h3]
There are four additional relics that can now be unlocked by achieving higher and higher gold scores during Normal Runs. Each of these relics give you an opportunity to earn EVEN MORE gold -- if you can handle the additional risks involved. I can’t wait to see the crazy new scores on the leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/b3c68d29e9474b833330fb91f8753be157610a02.gif[/img]
[h3]New Enemy: The Mimic[/h3]
Keep your eye on those treasure chests, ‘cause now they may be keeping their eyes on you! You know how much we love the Monster Manual and you know there’s no way we could go any further without adding mimics to the game. (You know, because you keep asking us to please put them in!) Mimics have a nasty bite, but if you can manage to defeat one, you’ll get an even bigger gold reward than what you would have found in a less toothy treasure chest.

[h3]Seeded Runs[/h3]
You can now enter a “seed” before your run. If anyone else enters the same seed, they’ll play the exact same dungeon with the same loot drops, enemy spawns, and everything else that’s usually randomized. Challenge your friend to a head-to-head! (This will work across all platforms, by the way, so don’t forget your console / iPhone friends.) Tell me what it’s like playing the dungeon built off your phone number, your middle name, or the first sentence of that book you still haven’t read because you’ve been playing too many video games. Just don’t go sharing your SSN on the internet. Stay safe, friends.

[h3]10 New Achievements[/h3]
We’ve beefed up the achievement roster by nearly 25%, and a few of them are real puzzlers. I promise they’re all doable! You just might need to figure out the right combo of relics, equipment, and trinkets to pull them off.

Whew! Okay, that’s the new stuff… but there are a lot more balance changes, UI improvements, and bug fixes we made too! Keep scrolling down below if you want allllllllllll the nitty gritty. And please, tell us what you think about the new update and what you’d like to see in the future. You can always reach us here, on [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]our Discord[/url], or [url=https://twitter.com/roundguardgame]on Twitter[/url].

<3
Andrea, Wonderbelly Games

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spawn rate changes: Orc Greasepunks, Phase Spiders, Dark Gelly Cubes, and Dark Elf Conductors are slightly more common. All other Gelly Cubes and Dark Elf Illusionists are slightly less common. Chaos rooms have more enemy variety and more treasure chests than previously. Chaos rooms now also have more enemies than a normal room. Fixed Green Gelly Cubes being overvalued in Act 1 so that they now leave room for more enemies.
[*] There are more large peg spots on many boards now. (More room for chests!)
[*] The bottom gold pile are now worth more in Act 2 and even more in Act 3.
[*] The treasure scarab now appropriately multiplies the gold values in the bottom gold piles when you complete a room.
[*] The treasure scarab can now perch on all medium-sized gold pots.
[*] Brilliance relic now burns WAY more of your mana every turn.
[*] Luck relic now only doubles the center gold pile value (previously was triple).
[*] Wisps now appear more immediately when you press the skill button so you don't miss as many wisp-ortunities.
[/list]

[h3]UI Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] There is clearer feedback on content you unlock along the way (for those of you who haven’t unlocked these already):  scarab, unstable potions, chaos rooms, and relics.
[*] There is clearer feedback to show that the scarab is multiplying your gold score.
[*] There is a countdown timer on the leaderboards showing when they will reset.
[*] The relic menu now tracks which hero you've mastered a relic with, so you can try to master it again with each hero!
[*] Properties that grant you bonus gold will now show a callout with the amount of gold when it's granted.
[*] There's now a visual indication of which save slot you're currently using on the save slot menu.
[*] Instinct relic timer UI now reveals/hides itself at smarter times between boards or when you quit.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Walls no longer kill your momentum if you approach at low speed.
[*] Fixed map generator sometimes creating a room that looked like it connected to 2 rooms from 1 exit.
[*] Healer's Hatchet buff no longer breaks in a number of ways in various odd circumstances.
[*] Getting an immunity now immediately wipes off any already existing debuffs, rather than only making you immune to future instances of that debuff.
[*] Fixed Team Warrior Jersey trinket occasionally getting you stuck with all immunities even when not at full health.
[*] Gold Powered Edge Sharpener trinket now works as intended. Hopefully you didn't notice what was wrong.
[*] Getting your hero to a higher level than we thought possible no longer causes problems.
[*] Fixed rare issue where the Trinket equip UI button seemed unresponsive to touch/mouse due to invisible blockers.
[*] Ledger can finally properly play dialog variations when you succeed on a full normal runs (rather than always playing his "first time" version).
[*] Hitting enemies inside the Wizard's bubbles now counts as a hit to open the cushion.
[*] The Wizard's lightning can now more reliably reach pegs at the edge of the board if you're on the far side of the room from them.
[*] Fixed mana sometimes getting overfilled by certain trinket effects.
[*] Water pool ambient sound no longer follows you back to the main menu if you save and quit during an Act 3 board.
[*] Cube Whistle trinket now actually works on the rainbow gellies if you meet the Gel Tamer a second time in a run.
[*] Wizard no longer sounds nervous whenever you look at her on the leaderboards.
[*] Fixed skill equip menu behaving oddly with non-English languages set. 
[*] Are you still reading? You’re an absolute treasure.
[/list]

notes.title: Treasure Hunter Update progress and our first sale!
notes.notes:
If you were waiting for a sale, now’s the time! Not only are we 25% off right now, but part of the proceeds will go to [url=https://indiemegabooth.com/farewell-(for-now)----a-letter-from-kelly-wallick,-founder-of-the-indie-megabooth/]help the Indie MEGABOOTH[/url] deal with the huge blow the pandemic has dealt them. They’ve been a massive force of support for indie developers over the last nine years, but with game conventions being a pretty dicey undertaking for the foreseeable future, they need to go into hibernation. They helped bring us to PAX West last year and they are very cool, very nice people. So if you haven’t bought our game yet, or you have a friend who needs a good distraction, it’s a good opportunity to support us and the Indie MEGABOOTH at the same time! 

Now when is new stuff coming, you ask? And what will the new stuff be? 

We’re currently working hard on adding some new modes and content to keep the game fresh. We’re calling it the Treasure Hunter Update, and it will include:

[b]Weekly Challenge runs:[/b] Seeded runs with crazy bonus rules that evolve each week! 

We’ll set your hero and starting loadout, add some bonus rule modifiers, and let you try to piece together a strategy to survive all the way through Act 3. How about a run with low gravity? All status effects are permanent? No health pots, but full room clear heals you? We’re making a big list of weird rules to play with and combine, and we hope they’ll push you all to explore new strategies and playstyles.  

Your first attempt will score on a dedicated leaderboard for that week’s challenge. But even if you don’t win on your first go, completing the challenge at any point during that week will still help you make progress toward new unlockable content. 

[b]Daily Puzzles: [/b]Super short seeded runs with absolute bananas rules that swap out every day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/f0a99f3d29fbb65e3f3eb51e8c38290d9c3d74a4.png[/img]

These will be more about adapting to super weird situations rather than building a sustainable strategy. Again, we’ll set the hero and starting loadout, along with more extreme rules: All rooms are Elites! You must clear each room within 3 turns or die! Your skills swap to random other skills every shot! There's an open demon portal in every room! You only have to manage for a few rounds to survive, so we can be a little crazier with these experiments. 

That new room type sticker at the bottom means you’ll earn a Golden Puzzle Piece for completing each Daily Puzzle run. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/849cb33139d079674b8a8cfc73a31b3b29a90cf0.gif[/img]

You’ll also get one from attempting the Weekly Challenge run, and even more if you manage to beat the Weekly Challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/3a9fa222647e775e9a403e750777c211803c5573.gif[/img]

Earning Golden Puzzle Pieces is how you’ll unlock some new Treasure Hunter themed content, like [b]bonus properties for the random loot pools[/b], and [b]new Relics[/b] to equip in normal runs so you can bring some of the crazy rules back to the original mode with you on your terms. 

Plus... we've slipped in [b]a sneaky new peg type[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/046f87b1ee0f6d6ff30eecf5c3ec71e73645e2b9.gif[/img]

You’ll never be able to trust a treasure chest again! 

All this juicy stuff will take a little while to get implemented, balanced, and localized. And COVID has thrown us for a bit of a loop as we try to balance running a game studio, taking care of our kid without preschool, and dealing with all the other stress that’s come along with it. But we’re still pressing forward! We expect it’ll take a couple of months to get the new update all ready to release. In the meantime, [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]join us on our Discord[/url] to share ideas for rules you think would be the most fun for Daily or Weekly runs, new bonus property and relic ideas, and new board layouts, and we might be able to include them in the update! 

And pssst. Maybe we’ll slip some of this stuff out in a special beta when it needs more eyes and testing. Lemme know if you’re interested.

As always, thank you for all the support and positivity! We’re really excited to keep expanding the game for you. Take care and stay safe out there!

<3
Andrea

notes.title: Roundguard Update: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you all! It's been amazing hearing all the love and general positivity, and frankly, we're just overwhelmed with the good feels. We're so glad we could share a smile with you all. But! We've also heard of a few issues and we're working to iron those out as fast as we can! Speaking of...

If you have any issues or feedback, the best place to get the quickest response is here in our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]https://discord.gg/roundguard[/url] . Plus, there are a ton of lovely people having fun and talking strategy! Come say hi!

Okay, without further ado...

[h1]PATCH 1.0.1[/h1]
[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Grit relic: Skills now cost a percentage of your max health instead of a flat 10. This will close down the infinite gold exploit that was dominating the gold leaderboard. It also makes this relic *much* harder to master. Try it out if you're looking for a real challenge!
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Grit relic now correctly checks health instead of mana when determining if you have enough to cast a skill. No more spamming skills after death or getting permanently locked from skill use if you got mana burned.
[*] Fixed rare soft lock if you had a certain quest and cast lots of projectiles.
[*] Taste for Gelatin Trinket now gives you 10 health, like it was supposed to.
[*] Fixed rare soft lock on the final boss.
[*] Scores now upload to the leaderboards more reliably at the end of a run.
[/list]

notes.title: Roundguard reinvents Peggle as an oddball dungeon-crawler
notes.notes:
Roundguard isn’t shy about its Peggle influences. And why should it? With no sign of another PopCap Games peg-pusher anytime soon, there’s a pachinko-shaped hole waiting to be filled. For Roundguard developers Wonderbelly Games, that means reimagining Peggle’s laser-focused arcade high-score chase as a roguelite dungeon-crawler.

All that’s missing is a little Ode To Joy.

notes.title: Roundguard October Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi friend!

Well, there went October. You all have to be tired of me starting every update like this, but seriously, what even is time? And how do I buy more of it?

Anyway, as we barrel towards our content complete deadline, we've been cramming in a ton of new content. New boards, new random encounters, new trinkets, new things to unlock... Oh! And a brand new boss fight! I don't want to spoil everything, but inspired by October, the spookiest of months, we decided we needed a heart-pounding final encounter...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/a5625634ec8b98275ece76abc7d1f591de658b8d.gif[/img]

As you can see, it is 100% anatomically accurate.

Of course, when you do beat that final boss, you need a reward. So now you'll get one of the Roundguard's powerful relics! Each relic changes the rules of the game in new and strange ways. Many make the game harder, but you might be able to use their effects to your advantage if you're clever. Before you start a new run, you can choose to activate one or more relics, and if you beat the game with them active, you'll master the relic and get a shiny gooooold version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/69a70c1e3182cdce66d00ac88fd8e055fe505c7c.gif[/img]

And in tomorrow's beta update, we'll be adding in another handful of stuff, including a new elite: The Goblin Poet. Because goblins are known for their eloquence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/d0b1c8d9be9fe0d7adff9f38b025a6df47eba8a8.gif[/img]

He puts the beat in beat poetry.

In between all of the Roundguard work, Kurt and I went to the Roguelike Celebration in San Francisco. We met a ton of wonderful folks, geeked out over procedural generation, and drank roguelike-themed cocktails. It was the best. I even gave a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2BHfpAF76J8&feature=youtu.be]mini design talk[/url], if you're into those. (If you are, you should check out the rest of the talks too!)

And guess what, San Francisco? We'll be back again this weekend, showing off Roundguard at the [url=http://www.dayofthedevs.com/]Day of the Devs[/url] event! There are going to be sooooooo many amazing indie games and it's all free. If you're around, come say hi! For all the rest of you who don't live in San Francisco, well... you can always find us in [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]the Discord[/url]. :)

<3
Andrea

notes.title: Roundguard September Dev Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/40e22b7d34c71853938a952c8806e32cc84d6830.png[/img]

Hi friend!

Is summer over already? Oh well. I’m pulling out the fuzzy blankets and steaming mugs of tea, ready to warm myself in the glow of my computer screen… Time for cozy game dev!

It was so lovely getting to see old friends and meet new ones at PAX West. The Indie MEGABOOTH experience was overwhelming at times – sorry to everyone who I had to stop mid-sentence to keep the booth running – but I was so proud of our little game. The Indie MEGABOOTH has been my favorite stop for years and years and this time we got to be at the heart of it! Thanks everyone for making it such a good time.

On the home front, our biggest new update is: Fizz the Wizard is fully playable!

Fizz is a young adventurer, still learning to control her magic, but she’s pumped to explore the dungeon and give it her all. All her frogs, that is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/a99580951c9ad2ad0404c723c6924b9cc5bbac92.gif[/img]

You may wonder where she keeps all those frogs. Well, you know what’s even better than dresses with pockets? Dresses with pocket dimensions.

Fizz has a bubbly personality and a talent for making (summoning) friends, but she’s no lightweight. She’s been electric on the leaderboards and the boss monsters cry out in terror when they see her frogs coming. But she’s also been a bit… buggy?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/ecae1ec063e40808c61404b97e76862ccd155454.gif[/img]

See, when she equips her lightning skill, lightning bugs appear on the side walls, pacing up and down, and her bolts zap in a line between her and the bugs. But as punishment to us for adding literal bugs to the game, these bugs have been the buggiest bugs ever to bug. There was that one time when they began multiplying into an enormous swarm that wouldn’t stop until it crashed your game. Or that other time when they just decided to take a vacation and disappear for no reason. I think after this next update we will have finally tamed these bugs, but I’m scared to say it too loudly in case they hear.

Anyway… Fizz has kept us busy, but we’ve been working away at lots more polish and tuning and new random encounters and all that good stuff. This weekend I asked the beta crew what they wanted more of in the game and they said level layouts. So I put some assets in the Goodies folder to let everyone build level ideas and it’s been a ton of fun getting those into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623604/0e824d51433633fa511a80fdea3cc3a144c26e66.gif[/img]

Maybe you have a level idea you’d like to see in the game? Come over to [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]the Discord[/url] and share it with us!

<3
Andrea

notes.notes:

Hey friend! How was your May?
 
I know I’m a little late with this, but we’ve shown off Roundguard at five events in three different time zones this month, so I guess what I’m saying is time is the enemy and I need a nap. But we’ve returned home victorious from our battles with the inexorable clock, laden with new laurels (Official Selection for Momocon and Dreamhack Dallas Showcases) and an actual golden bat for winning the PC Connect Pitch Competition. Epic loot drop! But of course, more important than the journey was all the friends we made along the way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/8270580b966037b1ea0207fc385daa0376612dc0.gif[/img]
Hi new friends!

So in between all that action, what happened on the game? Well, I completed an animation pass on all the remaining enemies. Ettins grumble and shout, minotaurs swing big axes, dark elf illusions burst with sparkly effects, magical beams crackle with energy… I still have plenty of polish work left to do, but at least everybody wiggles now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/fe374bbcddabe95c44da26169a527dbd7bff538d.gif[/img]

We dropped in a first pass at hover text, our theatre host now greets you with a proper introduction, and I did a tune up on the big jiggly eye monster boss on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/tanookifruit]my Twitch stream[/url]…

This is the kind of quality content you can expect from me.

And we got Chaos rooms added to the map generator. A Chaos room is like a Treasure room, but monsters from any biome can spawn in together. It’s CHAOS! (And oh, the new bugs this creates!)

What about the beta, you ask? Well, my friend, we are SO close. Like finger hovering over the red button close. We’re going to do our first test run with folks in Discord, so if you want in, come join [url=https://discord.gg/roundguard]the Roundguard Discord[/url] now.

Okay, things are about to get hot and spicy around here! Looking forward to a fun June…

notes.title: Roundguard March Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/f4cf01b3387c15589ca8f21e1ea7a4e45dba8332.png[/img]

How did this month go by so fast? I swear I was just crowing about our new bosses, and then it's just a blur of goblins and handshakes and my daughter puking everywhere and... Look, I survived March. Stronger, wiser (?), and ready to put some more spring into springtime. (You know, 'cause the heroes bounce? Eh, eh? Get it?)

Okay, what did we get done? We've added ten new peg types, including a two-headed tantrum-prone toddler ettin, an illusionist dark elf, a plane-hopping phase spider, way too many goblins, and a cabal of cultist skeletons determined to open a portal to the netherworld. Yeah, World 3 is gonna be wild.

[I tried to insert a GIF of a hot mess of portal demons but this scenario is so cursed even Steam won't touch it. Go check it out in the Discord.]

That wraps up the basic logic for all of World 3, so now I've just got to do a bunch of art and balancing work! (If you want to see more of how that comes together, swing by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tanookifruit]my Twitch channel[/url] and shout at me to stream again. It's been too loooooooong and I miss hanging out with all yous.)

We're also hard at work at getting online leaderboards fully up and running and all that boring backend stuff that's needed to run a beta. We're close! I keep saying the beta will be "soon" and you all know how good game developers are at estimating timelines, but we're definitely in SOON™ territory now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/bc4929235c3dd305d56435df4516534dc851b6ca.gif[/img]

Oof, deadlines.

Besides all that, we had a great time at SXSW and GDC. I met so so many new friends and personal heroes -- I even got the thumbs up on Roundguard from several of the original Peggle developers! (And learned a few of their secrets...) I got mounds of helpful feedback and I'm overwhelmed and exhausted but excited to get back to work! Let's do this!

I hope everyone is having fun at PAX East without us! Pop into the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/FVbjrbW]Roundguard Discord[/url] and tell us if you see any cool games we should check out. And while we're not at PAX East, we will be out on the east coast in a couple of months... I'll let you know the details as soon as its announced. :D
Talk again soon!

<3
Andrea

notes.title: Roundguard February Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/7ed0400e0b22eb3fc6996b7f3fb64ae0e8cbec6d.png[/img]

It's been busy over here at Roundguard HQ. We just completed a full pass of World 2, adding in lots of new monsters and traps including petrifying trolls, armored skeletons, mysterious rune stones, and orcs with steam blasters blowing everything around. (Rogues, beware. They can blast your arrows and smoke bombs too.) That brings our unique peg type total up to more than 40 and we've still got World 3 to go! But our biggest new addition is *dun dun dun* BOSS FIGHTS.

We wanted the world breaks to end with a bang, so we created a boss fight unique to each one. At the end of World 1 you'll face the alchemist with her collection of ever-changing unstable potions, and at the end of World 2 you'll take on this big guy...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/3b281b1a6b0356d19de2c977140dc0b3aa94e674.gif[/img]

While the bosses at the end of each world stay the same -- so you have something to strategize toward as you develop your build -- they each have procedural elements that change every run to keep you on your toes. New potions are brewed, eyeballs are shuffled, and topnotch threatening laughs are manufactured. (BWA + HA + HEE-HEE?) Okay, I  made that last one up.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623604/515579c80936ced0977b194ee6f0903f7662bdfa.gif[/img]

The next month will be jam-packed as we cram to get in the rest of World 3 and tidy things up for the beta. Plus we've got events! Roundguard was nominated for the Indie Pitch Competition at SXSW so Kurt and Bob will be down in Austin for that, and then I'm on my way to SF 'cause I got picked to join the Pixelles at GDC. If you're gonna be at SXSW or GDC, give us a shout! And of course, no matter where we are on the planet, you can always find us swapping bad puns and bug GIFs in the [url=https://discord.gg/FVbjrbW]Roundguard Discord[/url].

Talk again soon!

<3
Andrea
